title: Understanding Cross-Entropy Loss
text: Cross-entropy loss is particularly useful in classification problems because it measures the difference between two probability distributions. Think about how this might be more suitable than squared loss when dealing with probabilities.

title: Behavior of Squared Loss
text: Consider how squared loss behaves when the predicted probabilities are close to $$0$$ or $$1$$. What happens to the loss value in these cases?

title: Comparing Loss Functions
text: Which loss function is more sensitive to the differences between predicted probabilities and true labels?

title: Impact on Parameter Optimization
text: Think about how minimizing cross-entropy loss affects the optimization of parameters like beta. How does it guide the model to make better predictions?

title: Loss Function and Model Performance
text: Which loss function is more likely to lead to better performance in a binary classification task?
